judge: Agent visual review of CC0 contact sheets and source dimensions; not an independent human panel
rubric: 2 = strong visible match to all visual terms; 1 = partial/ambiguous match; unlisted = 0. Price eligibility is deterministic and applied separately. Small is a curator judgment informed by source dimensions, not proven by image scale alone.
success_gate: At least 8 of 10 tasks have a strong match in top 3; report nDCG@5 and precision@5 without changing labels after results. Warm uncached text encoding + ranking p95 < 1000 ms. No price violations. Price-only task passes if every returned item has a known price strictly below 50.
baseline: Unmodified openai/clip-vit-base-patch32; raw visual query after price extraction; normalized image/text embeddings, cosine ranking, no prompt tricks, reranking or label input.
